coverage.description: table maps first-column IDs to header/value zip maps; short rows omit keys, duplicate header names and IDs keep last values, blank lines disappear. agree_one retains supplied labels unless ordered rules change a field. P0 respects character voice and recognized original forms. P1 precedes P2/P3; P2 excludes IDs containing :books: and requires both assert probabilities >=0.2. P3-P5 are enabled only by PRAG_AGREE_ALL=1. Missing/bad numeric cells become zero, NaN comparisons are false; positive infinity remains accepted.
